corrections.name: paid mint qty 4 reverts (CORRECTED)
corrections.original: FAIL — insufficient funds (plain wallet held ~0.00457 tBNB after its x1 paid mint, but the script's qty-4 call sent value 0.00568 tBNB, so ethers failed at estimateGas before the contract's qty check could run; the qty cap was NOT proven by that attempt)
corrections.proof: eth_call mint(4) with value 0 from plain wallet 0x0e995Bf9B142C42A5c602Ed0b1b76580a53F3A07 reverted with exactly "qty 1..3" — mint() checks qty FIRST (before price), so value 0 reaches the qty check. Proves the max-3 cap live on testnet.

corrections.name: non-owner (deployer) withdraw reverts (CORRECTED)
corrections.original: FAIL — script regex /OwnableUnauthorizedAccount/ did not match ethers' rendering "execution reverted (unknown custom error)"
corrections.proof: Revert data was 0x118cdaa7 + deployer address 0x4f034A86EF3B1DAE84Ccba9764564304d2821B98. keccak('OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address)')[:4] = 0x118cdaa7 (verified in node). Re-ran deployer withdraw via staticCall: reverted with exactly 0x118cdaa70000000000000000000000004f034a86ef3b1dae84ccba9764564304d2821b98 — OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(deployer). Proves withdraw is owner-only live on testnet.

summary: 16 scripted live tests: 14 passed, 2 initially FAILed for harness reasons only. Both corrected with raw-RPC proofs above: final live result 16/16 proven on BSC testnet. Contract holds 0.00568 tBNB for the owner (user wallet).
